scope: Deep read-only diagnosis requested by user before suggesting next training; forward/teacher-forced and sampled gradient diagnostics only, no optimizer updates or weight changes.

teacher_forcing: Gold current answer continuations with actual generated previous replies, plus gold-history controls on later turns. These are conditional diagnostics, not fresh conversational successes.
